node.title: Re: Marketing and branding for The Perl Foundation (TPF) poll
node.author: haj
node.doctext:
I fail to find any indication that this survey is actually done on behalf of the Perl Foundation. TPF doesn't mention it, though their recent article [href://https://news.perlfoundation.org/post/communication_outreach|Can you help TPF with community communication?] or their blog in general, are suitable locations. The survey does not even claim to be originated by TPF, either.

So this could be just another e-mail harvesting scam.
